notes.title: Baklava Simulator V1.2 Update
notes.content:
Thief

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/519d9c0a44e25124c5f27828fb2452776a25c974.png

Thief Fixed, wage rate stabilized.

Cargo Vehicle

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/9935413e00c3576576d90410881ab5c6b73395ec.png

Our cargo vehicle now delivers the products you give faster to your warehouse. 


Customer

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/ee94432777bc09806a5836c33df355f42eb4988e.png

After the popularity system is removed, you will get many more customers in your store.


New Economic System

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/4b86a7117cf759e602e0698c6f6df36c2d5128ec.png

A new economic system was introduced.


Product Making Process

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/dcc6de3cafb18e0503f205a696d41549b7864aba.png

Dough kneading, dough rolling, baking, syrup and packaging times have been adjusted.

QUEST

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/0cf886abdaf85ddb698eab2fbb0f189ee3996174.png

The new mission system now has a notification system that will guide you through each mission. Both visually and in writing.


Voice

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/fe716c4c041ae76c14786f8df241adc14ad352d0.png

We are continuing our updates on in-game sounds and the next big update will be on sounds.


Information

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831344/c200ebca34436ebbc49618261a1d3ede2644c855.png

Please feel free to get back to me. Let us know your feedback and we will do our best to make the game better for you.

We wish you a good game.
